description:
🍨 Raspberry & Cream Gelato with Homemade Chocolate Fudge Pieces 🍫

This luscious raspberry and cream gelato is smooth, tangy, and bursting with real berry flavour—balanced perfectly with rich cream and chunks of chewy homemade chocolate fudge. Every bite is a dreamy blend of real fruit, velvety texture, and deep cocoa indulgence.

FUDGE: Make the fudge in this recipe, easy, fast and delicious 🤤  https://youtu.be/4gs4oOrHYbA?si=sabcy30R39QZLkHO for quick viewing its in the videos description. 

In this video, I’ll show you:
 • How to make a creamy gelato base with fresh raspberries
 • The secret to getting that perfect texture without eggs
 • A simple but decadent chocolate fudge recipe that holds up in frozen desserts
 • Tips for folding everything together to create a show-stopping scoop 

📍Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:06 Gelato base ingredients
1:59 Cooking the fruit
3:37 Blending the raspberries
5:55 Churning, chopping the fudge
7:38 Final scoop & taste test

Whether you’re a gelato lover or just craving something different, this recipe is worth the effort. Let me know in the comments if you try it!

🛒 Full recipe & measurements below in the description.
💬 Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more ice cream magic every week.
